messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm running a small docs blitz tonight to clear a handful of dead links and flaky examples. Preview CI is red for runtime/guides/cache-invalidation. Anyone able to grab it? I'll start a thread with specifics.

docs-bot: preview-build failed for branch docs-fix/cache-samples — see <https://ci.internal/build/1234|build/1234> :x:

ajay: I can take runtime/guides/cache-invalidation. What's failing?

maria: Thanks! The curl sample uses `pin_model` param which was renamed to `model_id` in the API. Preview shows 400s. File: /docs/runtime/guides/cache-invalidation.md

maria: current snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"pin_model":"redwood-large-1","prompt":"..."}'
```

maria: Should be:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-large-1","prompt":"..."}'
```

ajay: Copy. I'll update the snippet and run the local preview. Any other quick checks? :memo:

sam: Also check the JS SDK example in /docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md — we renamed the param there too last week.

ajay: Good catch, thanks @sam. I'll search for "pin_model" across the repo: `rg \"pin_model\"` and replace.

lucy: I can do review once the PR is up. Ping me for a quick pass. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Started build for PR #562 — docs-fix/cache-pinparam (ajay)

ajay: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/562 — updates curl + js snippet, fixes two dead anchors.

lucy: glanced at the diff — looks good. two tiny nit comments inline.

ajay: Addressed nits, pushed. build seems green now.

deploy-bot: preview site published: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/cache-invalidation — build 562 :white_check_mark:

maria: Amazing, thanks everyone. I'll re-run the link audit tomorrow morning but this closes the blocker for tonight. :party:

sam: Nice, leaving a note in the sprint doc about the param rename so other squads don't hit it.

ajay: Thanks all. Leaving thread
